{{ModeTabs|Story = No}} {{ModeInfobox |title1 = {{Color|EasyMode|Easy}} |image1 = EasyReworkIcon.png |waves = 20 |level_requirement = None |starting_cash = {{Money|500}}
{{Money|600}} (Group Bonus) |time = 7:00 |rewards = {{Coins|300}}, {{Exp|50}} & {{TowerExp|25}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For players who are new to the game or want a more relaxed experience.|Description in Elevators}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Easy''' mode, formerly '''Normal''' and '''Beginner's''' mode, is one of the six main Survival modes. '''Easy''' mode has 20 waves. It is not named after its final boss, the [[Brute]]. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. ==Rewards== ''For former rewards, see this mode's [[Easy Mode/Rewards|Rewards]] page.'' The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Currently, rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|250}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Only) |{{Exp|50}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) |{{TowerExp|10}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|15}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Easy''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. Additionally, items are sometimes not given out. These items are: *{{Color|Common}} (50%) **[[Grenade]] (1-2) **[[Flash Bang]] (1-2) **[[Molotov]] (1-2) **[[Easter Egg]] (1-2) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (30%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} *{{Color|Rare}} (20%) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} **[[Barricade]] **[[Supply Drop]] **[[Ducky Squad]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There are [[badges]] and achievements that you can or could obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside them. These are: {{Badge |title = Defeated the Brute |description = Defeat the Brute in Easy mode. |image = Aug25EasyBadge.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Recruit |description = Triumph in Easy mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|100}} }} {{Badge |title = Defeat Grave Digger |description = Get ready to have your grave dug! |image = D11EasyBadge.png |obtainable = No }} ===Seasons=== During some [[Passes]], the '''Normal''' mode could give currency rewards that you used to progress through a season. Rewards for all the seasons were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:0 auto" !Season !Rewards |- |[[End of Summer Season]] |{{Shells|120}} × (Waves/30)^1.75 |- |[[Season of Love]] |{{LoveLetter|25}}Originally was {{LoveLetter|15}} × (Waves/30)^1.75 |- |[[Solar Eclipse Event#Solar Eclipse Season|Solar Eclipse Season]] |{{SolarShard|15}} × (Waves/30)^1.75 |- |[[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season|Frost Invasion Season]] |{{Shards|15}}Before 16th of May 2021, it was {{Shards|25}}. × (Waves/30)^1.75 |- |[[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]] |{{Bell|5}}Before 18th of December 2024, the rewards were {{Bell|4}} per wave. per wave |- |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Battle Pass]] |{{DuckyEggs|5}} per wave |- |[[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] |{{BeachBalls|5}} per wave |- |[[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] |{{GumDrops|5}} per wave |- |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Battle Pass]] |{{PlushieSnowman|6}} per wave |- |[[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] |{{Bunz|6}} per wave |} ==Enemies== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:80%; margin:0 auto" |[[File:{{#choose:NormalAnim1.png|NormalAnim2.png|NormalAnim3.png}}|center|150px|link=Normal]] |[[File:{{#choose:SpeedyAnim1.png|SpeedyAnim2.png}}|center|150px|link=Speedy]] |[[File:{{#choose:SlowAnim1.png|SlowAnim2.png}}|center|150px|link=Slow]] |[[File:EasyModeNormalBoss.png|center|150px|link=Normal Boss]] |- |[[Normal]]

1 Total |} ==Wave Structure== In '''Easy''' mode, the formula for calculating the wave bonus on each wave is: :({{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|160}}) × (1 - 0.1 × Players) The wave clear bonus appears when every enemy from that wave was killed. It is 35% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo, trio and quad it is 20%. Before the 28th of January 2026, it was calculated as: :({{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|150}}) × (1 - 0.1 × Players) Before the 24th of February 2024, it was calculated as: :({{Money|180}} + ({{Money|100}} × Waves Completed)) ÷ Players Before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], it was calculated as: :({{Money|50}} - 5 × (Players - 1)) × Waves Completed The waves in '''Easy''' mode follow these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:0 auto" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-15 |1:00 |0:20Skip at 0:40. |- |16 |1:30 |0:30Skip at 1:00. |- |17-19 |1:30 |0:20Skip at 1:10. |- |20 |∞ |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut. For former wave structures of '''Easy''' mode, visit the [[Easy Mode/Waves|Waves]] page. The total number of enemies that spawn in '''Easy''' mode, excluding enemies that are summoned, is 380 enemies.
